title: Bridgewater Bancshares (BWB) Stock Fair Value Rises After Analysts Lift Earnings Outlook
summary: The fair value estimate for Bridgewater Bancshares has shifted from US$22.13 to US$24.00, pointing to an updated long term price target in the mid US$20s. This aligns with recent analyst research that has refreshed earnings expectations for 2026 and 2027 and reset price targets in the US$24 to US$25 range as they weigh upside potential against execution risk. As you read on, you will see how these changing targets and views contribute to the evolving narrative around Bridgewater Bancshares...
